page.layout: One printed page, right-hand side of the scan. Top: running head "SPECIALIS." centred. Below it: an index of 5 entries with page numbers at the right. Then the closing words "FINIS INDICIS." centred, and below them a woodcut ornament with no text. The left edge strip shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Usus politicarum legum, quæ Judæorum peculiariter accommodatæ fuerunt regimini vel reipublicæ. 811
Usus politicarum legum quæ Judæorum populo & ingeniis singulariter attemperatæ fuerunt. 813
Usus forensium vel politicorum, quæ perpetuam & immutabilem rationem habent in lege naturali & morali. 615
Usus legum, quæ de judiciis, illorumq; ratione latæ sunt. 816

page.notes: The left edge strip shows part of the neighbouring printed page with marginal text and numbers; it is not transcribed. The third entry is printed "615" as it stands; it may be a misprint for 815, but I have kept it as printed. The number on the last line also reads "813" and may be slightly unclear. The woodcut ornament below the closing words carries no text.
